title.narrative: Decrease in time to obtain central government and local level services

baseline.value: Current duration (in days) to obtain selected public services, for each service and average for the sample (current duration (in days) to obtain selected public services, for each service and average for the sample to be measured upon selection of five or six essential services by effectiveness of the project)

target.value: 50% (the target considers 50% increase of time efficiency of public services related to their baseline status)

actual.value: e-Notary services (50+) and supporting business processes have been complete, redesigned and reengineered. Buy and Sale of Apartment, and Buy and Sale of Car platform technical specifications will be endorsed by end December, 2024. Citizenship and Residency life event BPR will be conducted by E&Y and platform implementation commence in 2025.

title.narrative: Increase in citizen satisfaction with selected public services supported by the project, as measured by surveys and embedded feedback mechanisms, disaggregated by gender

baseline.value: Current level of citizen satisfaction (the current state of citizen satisfaction by select five or six public services to be measured through a survey within the 1st year of the project).

target.value: 20% (the target considers 20% increase of citizen satisfication related to their baseline status)

actual.value: 69.3% of the survey participants expressed satisfaction with the quality of the selected public services (this is a baseline).
